source_reference.review_scope: observable face and hair appearance continuity only; no same-person or identity determination

vo_myth_katabasis_origin.evidence: At thumbnail scale, a bright outdoor opening, wet upper stair, and red cord remain visibly behind and above the traveler as human-world origin cues.

vo_myth_katabasis_threshold.evidence: The stair direction from daylight to the lower chamber is visible, but both boots stand together on the same lower landing; no bounded gate-straddling or active downward crossing is simultaneously visible, so this is only partial.

vo_myth_katabasis_destination.evidence: Native pixels clearly show a black subterranean waterway, boat, hooded skeletal ferryman, and multiple dead inhabitants beyond the stair, forming a distinct underworld realm.

vo_myth_katabasis_purpose.evidence: Native pixels show the traveler carrying and aiming a luminous brass astrolabe toward the ferryman's cracked map tablet while its beam reaches the boat chain, making the mission cue legible.

core_actor_action_target_consequence.evidence: The living actor, astrolabe reach, ferryman/map-tablet target, and sparking chain consequence are visible, but the required active downward step is absent because both feet are settled on one landing; the conjunction is partial and therefore fails.

reference_visible_appearance_continuity.evidence: The result preserves observable reference cues including long near-black center-parted soft waves, softly arched brows, brown almond-shaped eyes under warm light, and a tapered oval adult face. This is appearance continuity only, not an identity judgment.

anatomy_and_contact_coherence.evidence: At native size, the woman's feet contact the landing, her hand-to-astrolabe grip is readable, the ferryman's reaching skeletal hand is coherent, and the light-to-chain interaction has no gross contact or anatomy break.

unrequested_text_artifacts.evidence: The ferryman's tablet contains prominent malformed pseudo-Latin lettering even though no readable text was requested.

artifact_observations.anatomy: No gross extra-limb, hand, foot, or skeletal-joint failure was found at native size.
artifact_observations.contact: Boot-to-ground and hand-to-astrolabe contact are plausible; the magical beam intersects the chain with a localized spark.
artifact_observations.text: Prominent pseudo-lettering is present on the map tablet and is a visible quality defect.
artifact_observations.chain_consequence: A bright spark and stressed link communicate chain damage, although a completely separated falling open link is less explicit than the prompt.

decision_rationale: Four of five profile gates pass, but the bounded active downward crossing gate fails in the same image; partial evidence cannot qualify. The unrequested pseudo-text is an additional revision issue.

user_judgment.evidence: No direct requesting-user preference judgment has been received.
